items.reason: Queen Amidala's text needs 'If you control an upgraded base', a base condition. Hopeful Volunteer's Piloting only attaches to a friendly Vehicle unit, so no offer can upgrade a base. The 'upgrades-attached' tag is wrong for a base-based payoff.

Mortar Trooper's 'Deal 1 damage to each of up to 3 ground units' can damage any unit, including your own. War Juggernaut's 'gets +1/+0 for each damaged unit' pays off that damage under the damaged-units want.
Always Two's text is 'Defeat all other friendly units', which is a cost it pays, not a benefit that rises with more fodder. The 'sac-fodder' tag rests on that cost, so the want does not hold.

Protectorate Fighter's 'create a Mandalorian token' gives a friendly body. Chimaera's 'You may choose a friendly unit and an enemy non-leader unit. If you do, defeat those units' can defeat that token as its fodder. Fighter's condition is met because Chimaera is itself unique.

Unauthorized Investigation's text is 'Create a Spy token' and it creates its own tokens. Nothing in the text refers to existing tokens, so the 'wants:tokens' tag rests only on 'curated cur-0086' and is not supported by the card text.

Milodon Rider's 'You may return another friendly non-leader unit to its owner's hand' can return Krrsantan, a non-leader unit. Krrsantan's 'When Played' can then be replayed, which the replay-when-played want covers.
Forced Pacification's 'Defeat any number of friendly units' can defeat Executor itself. Executor's 'When Defeated: Create 3 TIE Fighter tokens' then fires.
Jedi Trials says 'Attach to a Force unit.' Adept of Anger has the printed Force trait, so it is a valid host.
Aggressive Negotiations says 'Attack with a unit.' Rho Medical Shuttle can be the chosen attacker, and its 'When Played/On Attack: You may heal 1 damage' then triggers.

Children of the Watch creates 2 Mandalorian tokens, which are friendly units. The Student Guides the Master counts other friendly units 'with less power than it', but the token power is not in the evidence, so the wide-board count cannot be settled.
Sith Holocron says 'Attach to a Force unit.' Dooku has the printed Force trait, so it is a valid host.

Skyway Cloud Car's 'When Defeated: You may return a non-leader unit with 2 or less power to its owner's hand' can return your own Ferry Droid, which has 1 power. Ferry Droid's 'When Played' can then be replayed.

Rhydonium Detonation's 'Then, defeat all non-leader units' defeats Executor, which fires its When Defeated. Its 'Each player may return a non-leader unit to its owner's hand' lets you return Executor to replay its When Played.

Darth Maul's Lightsaber says 'If attached unit is Darth Maul, you may attack with him.' The extra attack is limited to Darth Maul, so it cannot give Captain Phasma's deployed On Attack an extra attack.
Dornean Gunship has the printed Vehicle trait. Rose Tico's 'Heal 2 damage from a Vehicle unit that attacked this phase' references Vehicle units.
Red Squadron Y-Wing has the printed Rebel trait. Fulcrum's 'Each other friendly Rebel unit gets +2/+2' applies to it, and Fulcrum's non-Vehicle restriction only limits the host.

Industrious Team's 'You may defeat a non-leader unit with 4 or less remaining HP' can defeat your own CR90 Relief Runner once its remaining HP is 4 or less. CR90's 'When Defeated: Heal up to 3 damage' then triggers.

Shatterpoint's 'Defeat a non-leader unit with 3 or less remaining HP' can defeat a friendly unit. Koska Reeves's 'If a friendly unit was defeated this phase, create a Mandalorian token' then fires in the same phase.
Fulminatrix has the printed First Order trait. Captain Phasma's 'You may give another First Order unit +2/+2 for this phase' references First Order units.

Darth Sion's only When Defeated text is 'return him to his owner's hand' at 7 or more power. It does not repeat or reward other units' When Defeated abilities, so the 'when-defeated-cards' want rests only on 'curated cur-0074'.
Reanimated Night Trooper has 'When Defeated: Look at the top card of a deck.' Chimaera's 'You may use a When Defeated ability on another friendly unit' can copy that ability.
Marrok has the printed Force trait. Nameless Terror's 'You may exhaust a Force unit' can target Marrok.

Refugee of The Path has 'When Played: You may give a Shield token to a unit with Sentinel.' Qui-Gon Jinn's Aethersprite says 'The next time you use a When Played ability this phase, you may use that ability again.' The repeat works when the Refugee's ability has a legal target.
Elzar Mann's text says 'While you control a Force leader, this unit enters play ready.' It refers to a Force leader, not a unit. Ben Kenobi is a non-leader unit, so it does not satisfy the want.
The Ghost has the printed Vehicle trait. L3-37's text 'you may instead attach her as an upgrade to a friendly Vehicle unit without a Pilot' references Vehicle units.
